title: Azriyau rebels against Tiglath-Pileser III
summary: Azriyau, a rebel king in northern Syria, rises against Tiglath-Pileser III.
description: Azriyau, a rebel king in northern Syria, rises against Tiglath-Pileser III. Event record added from Griffith & White’s Reply to Beckman, Part 2 (Table 1, row 738, p. 38).

sorting_basis.note: Tier 2: CFAH Reply to Beckman (Griffith & White, Part 2): 738 BC.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "A Reply to Beckman’s Defense of Thiele’s Chronology, Part 2: An Objectivist Answer to the Assyrian Synchronisms," OSF preprint v2.10 (2025), doi:10.17605/OSF.IO/DT6GX, Table 1, row 738, p. 38
chronologies.note: Azriyau was the king of a principality in north-west Syria, not Uzziah of Judah (after Na’aman and Shea).
